svg.title: Mack Tully, main character of Timmaz Hard
svg.desc: Poster-style full-length illustration of Mack Tully, a sturdy man in his late twenties with dark brown hair and stubble, wearing an open red-and-black checked bush shirt over a black singlet, navy rugby shorts, grey work socks and black boots, holding a set of car keys. Behind him a mustard ute with a farm dog on the tray is parked on a gravel lay-by, with sheep paddocks, a power pole, the snow-capped Southern Alps and a nor'west arch cloud overhead.
